summary: The preparer referenced the Board's review as documentation of alternatives to Section 4(f) land use, directing readers to Appendix G and Chapter III for the full record.
text: During the preparation of the final statement a review of the Roosevelt School Property involvement was conducted by the Board of Education, District No. 170 (See page G-7). Additional information from the review of the status of the Roosevelt School Property involvement is documented in a letter from the United States Department of the Interior, dated November 7, 1974 and contained in Appendix G, page G-5; Sheet 1 of 9 evaluation and disposition of U.S. Department of Interior Comment 1.a); and in Chapter III, page III-7.
